firstPlayerRule: Roll the die to determine who goes first. The first player then rolls and moves clockwise.
houseFallback: If players tie for the highest roll, those players roll again.
interpretation: This site reads “roll the die to determine who goes first” as the highest roll going first.
internalEvidence: Fetched the publisher-hosted PDF linked from instructions.hasbro.com (Mouse-Trap-Game) and extracted its text with pdftotext. PDF page 1: "Roll the die to determine who goes first." "The first player rolls the die and moves clockwise that number of spaces along the path." Item C0431, © 2016 Hasbro.
uncertainty: The rules do not say whether high or low wins the roll, or how to break ties.
